hyperparameter_policy: Existing C2 hyperparameters remain fixed; this context packet defines no development cohort or selection rule.
independence: All 40 contexts were authored by the same agent in one pool. Test contexts do not have an independent author. These are fresh fictional settings for the existing formal token-location task, not new abstract reasoning families.

production_rules.balanced_domain_categories: Eight broad context domains, each with two fit and three test contexts.
production_rules.balanced_framing_templates: Four neutral introduction/channel template pairs, each used by four fit and six test contexts.
production_rules.actor_policy: Two-word plausible ASCII actor names; individual name components and full location entities are unique within this pool and checked against prior authored and compiled banks.
production_rules.context_assignment: Fit and test use the same production rules. Actor assignments are placeholders for the declared later pool shuffle.
